system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

As a bonus action, you can transfer your Elemental Flux to another creature you can see within 30 feet of you by spending 1 Superiority Die. When you do, your Elemental Flux state immediately ends, and the select creature gains the benefits of whatever Elemental Flux type you had when this maneuver was used until the beginning of your next turn. While they are benefiting from Elemental Flux, you can spend your Superiority Die to activate maneuvers for them, allowing them to benefit from your maneuvers for the duration.
